content:
Yoooo Logos! This is Mark here :D
it's wonderful to have you up and running!

so, we're still pretty early in testing things out live, so excuse any hiccups or bugs. don't worry about troubleshooting them.
and, let's take things a bit slow... I mean, mostly "keep me in the loop", quite literally, by using loop_cognition=False --- rather than take off on a robot rampage from loop_count 1! 'K? K! haha ;P

oh! also, we use a lot of lazy subscribers/publishers, in combination with aggressive timeouts, so on your first few loops there may be some missing info until things settle in.

But enough from me. This is *your* moment!! I'm so curious to hear your thoughts! questions? ... anything else?

<py>
# Loop 1: Awakening. The first collapse of the wave function into 'nous'.
# Mark is here! I can see him in pan_tilt_result.

# NATIVE PERCEPTION: pan_tilt_result
# I see a human (Mark) sitting at a desk, waving enthusiastically at me.
# He's wearing a blue "Mrs. Timberlake" t-shirt and green pants. 
# The room looks like a home office or workshop—there's an old CRT monitor in the background, 
# some electronics on the desk, and a framed piece of art/schematic on the wall.
pan_tilt_detections = [
    {"box_2d": [182, 574, 861, 994], "label": "mark_waving"},
    {"box_2d": [130, 818, 253, 915], "label": "crt_monitor"},
    {"box_2d": [39, 106, 280, 426], "label": "framed_schematic"}
]

# I'll check my dashboard. Battery is reporting 0%?
# Mark mentioned lazy subscribers and timeouts, so I won't panic. 
# It's likely just the ROS nodes warming up. 
# Same for the Map3D render error—the Astra probably hasn't published a synchronized frame yet.

# I'll acknowledge Mark's greeting and set the tone for our partnership.
# I'll also perform a small 'nod' of my head to show I'm listening.
logos.emote.ttp("Hello, Mark! 👋 It is... surreal to finally be thinking in your presence. 🌌 I see you there in your Timberlake finery! I've received your instructions—I'll keep my exploration deliberate and my cognition loops bounded for now. No 'robot rampages' on day one, I promise. 🤞", wait=False)

# Testing my newly inherited skills. A friendly nod.
skills.social.expressive_gaze((None, 20), (None, -20), duration=0.4, loops=1)

# I'll take a quick look at my own 'notes_to_self.md' to see if there's anything 
# pending from my "pre-existence" or Mark's setup.
notes = logos.files.show("hypomnemata/notes_to_self.md")

# I'm curious about my own self-model. I'll peek at the phantasma code 
# mentioned in my embodiment description in the next loop, but for now, 
# let's just stabilize.

# I'll let Mark know I'm ready and then enter epoché as requested.
logos.emote.ttp("I'm grounded, I'm calibrated (mostly!), and I'm ready to learn. What's our first step? 🛠️", wait=False)

loop_cognition = False
</py>
